name: Static Web App
summary: Static Web App for a frontend, SPA or documentation site, with a managed global CDN and an optional Standard-tier private endpoint.
useWhen: You need to host a static frontend, single-page app or documentation site
You want a managed global CDN in front of static content
avoidWhen: You need a server-rendered app with a long-running backend process (use App Service or Container Apps)
The site must be fully private from day one on the Free tier (private endpoints need Standard)
You want the resource's native GitHub/DevOps CI/CD integration (the upstream Terraform module does not expose it; deploy separately instead, see the README)
